title: EscapeRoute: sandbox escape in Anthropic's filesystem MCP server
summary: Anthropic's filesystem MCP server checked allowed directories with a string prefix match and fell back to validating a symlink's parent directory rather than its target, so an agent could be steered into reading and writing files outside its sandbox. Cymulate demonstrated escalation to system files such as /etc/sudoers and LaunchAgents plists.
severity_rationale: Full escape from the directory sandbox that is the server's only security control, reaching code execution when it runs as a privileged user.
